summary: Tested Nifty 50 Breadth feature (new addition to Market Intelligence panel). Backend: 21/21 tests pass. API returns breadth object with advances=16, declines=33, total=50, signal=MILD_BEAR, signal_label='Mild Bearish', impact_label='-80 to -180 pts'. Matrix rows all have breadth_ref field with correct values (28+, 22-27, 18-22, 12-17, <12). Frontend: N50 Breadth compact card shows '16 / 50 Mild Bearish' with mini bar in data strip. BreadthCard section shows advance-decline bar with both Stocks Down and Stocks Up reference tables (toggle works). Decision Matrix has 9 columns with 'Breadth (Up)' header. Brent regression confirmed: $91.60 (non-zero).

issues: UP_ROWS table has a coverage gap: ranges defined are 35+, 25-34, <15. Range 15-24 (advances) is missing. With advances=16, no row gets highlighted in the Stocks Up table. Minor design issue — current declines-focused row correctly highlights 25-34 in Stocks Down table.

action_items: Optional: Fix UP_ROWS gap in MarketIntelPanel.jsx - add a row for '15-24' range in Stocks Up reference table so that advances=15-24 also gets an active highlight row. Currently ranges 35+, 25-34, <15 leave a gap for 15-24 advances.
critical_code_review_comments: UP_ROWS in MarketIntelPanel.jsx defines only 3 ranges (35+, 25-34, <15), leaving a gap for advances 15-24. The isActiveUp function for '<15' uses advances < 15, so advances=16 (today's data) won't highlight any row in Stocks Up table.

Signal enum in _breadth_signal() goes up to STRONG_BULL (35+ advances) but Decision Matrix breadth_ref for 'Strong Bullish' row is '28+' — these are intentionally different dimensions (live signal vs reference range) and work correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Breadth feature fully implemented and verified. API: advances=16, declines=33, total=50, signal=MILD_BEAR. Data strip card: card-n50-breadth shows '16/50 Mild Bearish'. BreadthCard section: data-testid=breadth-card with full advance-decline bar. Reference toggle: data-testid=breadth-ref-toggle toggles Stocks Down / Stocks Up tables. Decision Matrix: 9 columns, Breadth (Up) column with values 28+/22-27/18-22/12-17/<12 stocks. Brent=$91.60 (non-zero). Minor design note: UP_ROWS gap for advances 15-24. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_breadth_feature.py (21 tests).
